aw26.title: Autumn/Winter 2026
aw26.intro: Rich, maximal and tactile. Big outerwear, sharp tailoring and heavy embellishment, with 1920s glamour running through evening and footwear.
themes: Drop waists, fringe, pearls and T-bar heels bring 1920s glamour into evening and daywear.
Pinstripes, pointed shoulders and double-breasted suits in slate and navy.
Rugby shirts, cricket knits and statement collars from the playing field.
Shearling, fur collars and leather bombers, oversized and protective.
Beads, sequins and sheer layers move onto everyday pieces.

coty.name: Cloud Dancer
coty.text: A soft, airy white chosen as a calm reset. Use it as the base for knits, shirting and winter whites, and as the light partner to oxblood and slate.

coty.name: Transformative Teal
coty.text: A blue-green between ocean and forest. Strong on outerwear, leather and knitwear, and as an accent on footwear.

aw26.sources: Season themes summarise published AW26 runway, retail and trade coverage, including Who What Wear, Harrods and Trendalytics. Colours of the year are Pantone 2026 (Cloud Dancer) and WGSN × Coloro 2026 (Transformative Teal).

ss27.title: Spring/Summer 2027
ss27.intro: The waist returns and handcraft moves into everyday clothes. Shapes get defined again, sneakers step back for elegant shoes, and a bright luminous blue leads the palette.
themes: Peplums, basque waists and bubble hems bring shape back after years of oversizing.
Lace, embroidery and smocking move onto crisp everyday shirting.
Exposed straps, unfinished hems and muslin-like cottons.
Fringe and bold stripes that move with every step.
The tie returns, tucked shirts look sharp again and refined flats replace sneakers.
Cut-offs, wax-coated finishes and denim suits.

coty.name: Luminous Blue
coty.text: A bright, optimistic blue with a glow. Use it head to toe on summer tailoring and shirting, or as a sharp accent against clay and stone.

ss27.sources: SS27 themes summarise published runway and trade coverage from the September–October 2026 shows, including FashionUnited and The Zoe Report. Colour of the year is WGSN × Coloro 2027 (Luminous Blue); Pantone announces its 2027 colour in December 2026.

aw27.title: Autumn/Winter 2027
aw27.intro: Early outlook. SS27 signals carried into winter: waisted outerwear, handcraft on knits, quiet structure and warmer earth tones, with luminous blue deepening for the cold season.
themes: Belted and double-belted coats keep the defined waist going into winter.
Smocking and tonal embroidery move onto knits and wool.
Pleated wool trousers, funnel necks and clean closures.
Luminous blue darkens into ink and cobalt for winter.
Flat riding boots and slim soles replace chunky lugs.

coty.name: Luminous Blue
coty.text: The 2027 colour carries into winter. Expect it in deeper cobalt and ink versions on knitwear, wool coats and leather accessories.

aw27.sources: AW27 runway shows take place in February–March 2027, so this season is a Forecut projection built from SS27 runway signals and the 2027 colour of the year. It will be updated as runway coverage arrives.

ss28.title: Spring/Summer 2028
ss28.intro: Long-range outlook. Structured clarity and easy movement: fewer, better pieces with performance comfort for commuting, anchored by a warm earth orange.
themes: Clean shapes and fewer, better pieces instead of constant novelty.
Articulated sleeves, stretch and breathable fabrics for movement.
Stretch suiting and hidden closures made for city days.
Natural fibres finished to perform: quick-dry, UV-resistant, easy-care.
Cushioned sport soles under refined flats, loafers and derbies.

coty.name: Radiant Earth
coty.text: A warm, grounded burnt orange described as a reliable but assertive neutral. Works as a base for tailoring and knitwear or as a strong accent on accessories.

ss28.sources: SS28 is a long-range Forecut projection. It builds on early SS28 trade coverage (structured clarity and performance design, FashionUnited) and the WGSN × Coloro 2028 colour of the year, Radiant Earth.

aw28.title: Autumn/Winter 2028
aw28.intro: Long-range outlook. Functional tailoring and technical wool for winter, hidden closures and hybrid boots, with radiant earth deepening into rust and brick.
themes: Belted jackets, useful pockets and clean seams.
Wool that stretches, sheds rain and resists creases.
Radiant earth turns to rust and brick for winter.
Smart boots on cushioned sport soles.
Magnetic and concealed fastenings for clean fronts.

coty.name: Radiant Earth
coty.text: The 2028 colour moves into winter as deeper rust and brick. Strong on wool coats, suede and leather boots.

aw28.sources: AW28 is a long-range Forecut projection based on SS28 direction and the WGSN × Coloro 2028 colour of the year, Radiant Earth. It will be refined as SS28 and AW28 coverage arrives.
